source: Georgia's K-12 ELA Standards: Foundations, Language, Texts, & Practices, Grades 3-5 (approved May 2023), 52 pp. Parent (STANDARD) statements transcribed by pdftotext -layout from the page that holds the grade 3 expectations table. When the same standard is printed with different words on another page (a table of contents), those are listed in otherWordings. Footnote asterisks are dropped.

parents.name: Decoding & Encoding with Phonics
parents.wording: Use knowledge of phonics to decode and encode grade-level words.

parents.name: Oral & Silent Reading Fluency
parents.wording: Demonstrate oral and silent reading fluency to read grade-level texts for understanding, self-correcting as necessary to ensure accuracy and aid comprehension.

parents.name: Read Cursive
parents.wording: Read texts written in cursive.

parents.name: Write Cursive
parents.wording: Use fine motor skills to form legible letters and words in cursive.

parents.name: Grammar, Usage, & Mechanics
parents.wording: Learn and apply conventions of Standard English grammar, usage, and mechanics to aid the comprehension and analysis of texts and to communicate clearly and precisely in written and spoken language.

parents.name: Syntax
parents.wording: Apply understandings of sentence structure to comprehend and compose varied sentences.

parents.name: General, Academic, & Specialized Vocabulary
parents.wording: Acquire and use general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words and phrases with precision in a variety of settings.

otherWordings.wording: Acquire and use general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words with precision in a variety of settings.
Acquire and use general, academic, and specialized vocabulary words with precision in a variety of settings.

parents.name: Word Analysis
parents.wording: Acquire and apply word analysis skills to determine the meanings of words and to communicate with precision in a variety of settings.

parents.name: Meaning & Purpose
parents.wording: Make connections between words and phrases and use reference materials to determine or clarify word meanings in a variety of settings and for a variety of purposes.

parents.name: Purpose & Audience
parents.wording: Use knowledge of purposes and audiences, as well as the language that develops those relationships, to make meaning of texts in multiple modes.

parents.name: Authors & Speakers
parents.wording: Make connections between authors of texts, speakers in texts, varying perspectives, and the circumstances in which texts are produced.

parents.name: Organization
parents.wording: Demonstrate and apply understanding of organizational structures and elements to create coherent and engaging texts.

parents.name: Craft
parents.wording: Use language to interpret meaning and craft engaging texts.

parents.name: Narrative Techniques
parents.wording: Explain, analyze, and use narrative techniques to shape understandings.

parents.name: Expository Techniques
parents.wording: Explain, analyze, and use expository techniques to shape understandings.

parents.name: Opinion Techniques
parents.wording: Explain, analyze, and use opinion techniques to shape understandings.

parents.name: Poetic Techniques
parents.wording: Explain, analyze, and use poetic techniques to shape understandings.

parents.name: Research & Inquiry
parents.wording: Conduct research to ask and answer questions that clarify, deepen, and extend understanding of a topic of interest using credible sources and communicating relevant and accurate information.

parents.name: Curating Sources & Evidence
parents.wording: Integrate evidence from print and digital sources, assessing credibility and relevance and avoiding plagiarism.

otherWordings.wording: Reference parts of texts to address a specific topic or question and explore various sources of information to make connections across a broad range of topics.
Reference parts of texts to address a specific topic or question and explore various sources of information to make connections across a broad range of topics.

parents.name: Reader & Writer Identity
parents.wording: Build an identity as a reader and writer, developing a repertoire of resources and tools to continuously expand participation as an active consumer and producer of texts.

parents.name: Engagement & Intention
parents.wording: Engage in written or spoken dialogue as author and audience for a variety of tasks and purposes, making intentional connections within, between, and beyond texts.

parents.name: Comprehension Strategies
parents.wording: Engage with a range of complex texts for a variety of tasks and purposes, accessing and using strategies for comprehension before, during, and after reading as part of the meaning-making process.

parents.name: Writing Processes
parents.wording: Compose a range of texts for a variety of purposes and audiences, flexibly engaging in writing processes to plan, draft, evaluate, revise, and edit texts.

parents.name: Context
parents.wording: Develop and apply knowledge of key components of context such as background information, geographic location, cultural influences, time period, and contemporary events when interpreting and constructing texts.

parents.name: Author, Audience, & Purpose
parents.wording: Interpret and construct texts by developing and applying knowledge of the strategies and techniques authors use to accommodate the target audience and achieve the text’s purpose.

parents.name: Reading like a Writer
parents.wording: Interpret texts through the author’s lens by identifying, analyzing, and evaluating craft techniques that are connected to the responses, thoughts, decisions, and questions triggered by the text.

parents.name: Writing like a Reader
parents.wording: Construct texts with the audience’s experience in mind, basing decisions about craft techniques on context and purpose.

otherWordings.wording: Construct texts with the audience’s experience in mind, basing decisions about craft techniques on knowledge of context, author, audience, and purpose.
Construct texts with the audience’s experience in mind, basing decisions about craft techniques on knowledge of context, author, audience, and purpose.

parents.name: Text Design
parents.wording: Consider the impact of text design on audience and purpose when consuming and producing texts across modes and genres.

otherWordings.wording: Consider the impact of text design on audience and purpose when consuming and producing texts across a range of modes and genres.
Consider the impact of text design on audience and purpose when consuming and producing texts across a range of modes and genres.

parents.name: Collaboration
parents.wording: Collaborate with others to accomplish shared goals and projects.

parents.name: Presentation
parents.wording: Use presentation skills to tailor communication to target audiences for specific purposes.
